astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: Milky Way over Yellowstone
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: The Milky Way was not created by an evaporating lake.  The colorful pool of water, about 10 meters across, is known as Silex Spring and is located in Yellowstone National Park in Wyoming, USA.  Illuminated artificially, the colors are caused by layers of bacteria that grow in the hot spring.  Steam rises off the spring, heated by underground magma associated with the Yellowstone Hotspot.
